details: Linux 1.0.68: reads started on ttyUSB2, ttyUSB3, then ttyUSB2 again; the last failed 'Block failed checksum' about 20 s in. Radio-initiated clone of 131-byte frames; a misaligned or stale first frame fails its checksum. The FTM-300 prompt ('press the DIAL knob') got no 'press now' cue.
summary: First clone frame failed checksum after repeated read attempts
